01

The product

What is MILEX™ Thermal MAX®?

Nature's alternative. MILEX™ is made from a special type of domestically grown Sorghum Vulgare, commonly referred to as "Milo".

The process begins when our farmer-growers deliver naturally grown, non-GMO sorghum seeds, or "berries", to our processing mill in Tulia, Texas. These tiny sorghum berries undergo our patented manufacturing process where they are passed through state-of-the-art equipment. Once refined, they are extruded at high speed with more than 3000 psi, creating our amazing Thermal Puffs™: MILEX™.

  1. 01HarvestNon-GMO sorghum berries delivered by local farmers.
  2. 02ProcessRefined through patented state-of-the-art equipment.
  3. 03ExtrudeHigh-speed extrusion at 3000+ psi creates Thermal Puffs™.

Performance

Built to outperform

The secret

It's all in the "PUFF"

MILEX™ Thermal Puffs™ are the secret to its outstanding thermal resistance properties. Each puff contains thousands of tiny air pockets that create an amazing thermal blanket. And since MILEX™ resists shrinking and settling far better than traditional materials, those tiny air pockets stay intact, helping MILEX™ retain its insulation value year after year.

03

Sustainability

Why use sorghum?

Sorghum makes the perfect insulation because it expands naturally without the use of expensive, potentially hazardous polymers, making it a safer, more sustainable choice than expandable materials that rely on those polymers.

It has a much lower carbon footprint than other grains. Sorghum is known as one of the most water efficient crops grown, largely due to its drought tolerance properties, and is recognized as one of the most efficient crops in converting solar energy and water use.

  • Drought tolerant
  • Low carbon footprint
  • Solar efficient
  • Biodegradable to ISO standards
04

Safe & clean

Naturally pest-free

During our exclusive processing technique, all fats and sugars are removed, rendering MILEX™ a "non-food" source.

  • Pests and insects are naturally not attracted to it.
  • Naturally occurring boric powder is used during our curing process. MILEX™ self-extinguishes and will not sustain combustion, and the boric powder adds pest protection.
  • Free of potentially harmful polymers. Virtually dust-free and non-toxic, non-irritant.
